description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~2628785~~) operation to query the IDs of instances.
The description of the security group rule.

description.zh:
传输层协议类型，取值如下：

- TCP
- UDP
description.en:
The type of the transport layer protocol. Valid values:

*   TCP
*   UDP

description.zh:
目的端安全组开放的传输层协议（TCP/UDP）相关的端口范围。

取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
description.en:
The range of destination ports over which TCP and UDP traffic is allowed in the security group rule.

Valid values: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port number and the end port number with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.

description.zh: 源端IP地址范围。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The range of source IP addresses. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.
